evidence: Original 24A446 routines invoked in the fixed GPU010 QEMU kernel using real IOSurface factory/allocate and explicit synthetic properties. Plain plane0 falls back to global layout; single-plane &BGA used distinct global/plane row bytes and a 4096-byte offset. Not phone surface values.
limits: Presentation requires one supported plane, base equal to offset and size within the descriptor. Extended-pixel origins are refused. No compression decoding or arbitrary format support is claimed.

_native_legacy_surface_handle.scope: Original field at0x10 is passed by the original destructor as the surface handle to the handle-table removal; frontend IOSurface-ID correlation remains a runtime check.

handle_evidence.method: Project kc_image and exact raw instructions; REA native provider unavailable on Windows
